purpose: Resolve implementation encodings, resource ceilings, workflow separation, and fail-closed execution semantics required by the already-frozen Stage 1 development design before any Stage 1 scientific outcome generation.

implementationEncodingContract.canonicalHash: SHA256 of recursively key-sorted compact JSON; arrays retain order
implementationEncodingContract.phaseAssignment: sha256(`${salt}|${decimalSeed}`), first 32 bits interpreted unsigned, modulo 2; even/odd mapping from frozen Stage 1 spec
implementationEncodingContract.historicalTrajectoryHash: canonicalHash({length: rawStateKeys.length, rawStateKeys}), with ordered RAW keys from initial observed state through final observed terminal-or-maxPly state inclusive
implementationEncodingContract.openingPrefixHash: canonicalHash({length: openingMoveKeys.length, moveKeys: openingMoveKeys}) using exact move keys in chronological order
implementationEncodingContract.historyWindowHash: canonicalHash([{rawStateKey,moveKey},...]) oldest-to-newest over exactly the selected pre-root window
implementationEncodingContract.gameRng: one tools/benchmark.js seededRandom(seed) stream per source game; opening draws and subsequent generator analyzeMove calls consume the same stream in chronological order
implementationEncodingContract.exactMoveOrdering: lexical ascending exact move key over engine moveVariants
implementationEncodingContract.continuationRng: for each exact root move and replicate index, instantiate a separate seededRandom from sha256-first32(`${RCPR-S1-CONT-v1}|${rawStateKey}|${rootActor}|${replicateIndex}`); same derived seed is used across root moves at the same replicate index
implementationEncodingContract.continuationTermination: apply exact root move first, then normal-policy moves until terminal or 200 post-root continuation plies; unfinished is non-estimable and never encoded as draw

diagonalLda.classVariance: population variance dividing by class row count, then max with 1e-6 variance floor
diagonalLda.pooledVariance: max((floored positive variance + floored negative variance)/2, 1e-6)

implementationEncodingContract.familySetFoldRankingTieBreak: fold AUROC descending, active feature count ascending, family-set id ascending
implementationEncodingContract.operatingThresholdCandidates: unique observed pooled OOF scores only; score>=threshold; frozen support constraints and ranking from Stage 1 spec

resourceContract.authorizationResourceGate: PASS only because both production and independent slowest-sampled projections are individually below their 360-minute job ceilings after job separation; this is feasibility evidence, not a runtime guarantee

executionConsumptionAndFailureContract.preAuthorizationOrSourceHashFailure: NOT-CONSUMED; no scientific development is entered
executionConsumptionAndFailureContract.consumptionBoundary: runner writes execution-start.json after authorization/spec/addendum/source-hash/clean-tree validation and immediately before invoking the fresh Stage 1 development pipeline
executionConsumptionAndFailureContract.afterConsumptionBoundary: fresh Stage 1 seed block is treated as consumed even if process, workflow, infrastructure, timeout, memory, serialization, production, or independent verification later fails
executionConsumptionAndFailureContract.failureAfterConsumptionBoundary: STAGE1-TECHNICAL-INVALID; no repair-and-rerun on the same Stage 1 evidence block within RCPR-STUDY1; Stage 2 remains not authorized
executionConsumptionAndFailureContract.independentVerificationFailureAfterProdu: STAGE1-TECHNICAL-INVALID; production outcomes are not promoted and the Stage 1 seed block remains consumed
executionConsumptionAndFailureContract.workflowCancellationOrTimeoutAfterProduc: fail closed as consumed unless repository evidence proves the runner never crossed execution-start boundary
